-- MOCK DATA (fake distances and judgements): see docs/contracts.md
SELECT p.fi_sent, fi.text AS fi_text, p.other_lang, p.other_sent, o.text AS other_text, p.distance
FROM lang_pair p
JOIN lang_sentence fi ON fi.lang = 'fi' AND fi.page_id = 1137 AND fi.sent_no = p.fi_sent
LEFT JOIN lang_sentence o ON o.lang = p.other_lang AND o.page_id = p.other_page AND o.sent_no = p.other_sent
WHERE p.wikidata_id = 'Q29207'
ORDER BY p.fi_sent, p.other_lang;

SELECT fi_sent_no, other_lang, other_sent_no, label, reason, tone_fi, tone_other,
       fi_claim, other_claim, same_specific_fact, model
FROM pair_judgement
WHERE wikidata_id = 'Q29207'
ORDER BY fi_sent_no, other_lang, other_sent_no, model
